evidence: DIFF A hunk 1 (lines 1-3): 3-line migration header comment only (purpose, puppet-nginx 8.4.0 dependency, expected run-2 events); no code.

DIFF A hunk 2 (smtps_${domain} mailhost, line 81): raw_prepend ['proxy_smtp_auth          on;'] -> proxy_smtp_auth => 'on'. Module-API translation, same value: puppet-nginx 8.4.0 mailhost.pp:165 declares Enum['on','off'] $proxy_smtp_auth = 'off' and mailhost_common.epp:27-29 renders 'proxy_smtp_auth <value>;' unconditionally when nginx >= 1.19.4 (node has 1.24.0), so the raw line would be a duplicate directive. Node result: /etc/nginx/conf.mail.d/smtps_p8test.example.com.conf:8 holds exactly one 'proxy_smtp_auth on;', nginx -t ok. No resource added/removed/retitled, all other attributes unchanged.

DIFF A hunk 3 ($smtp_helo mailhost, line 92): raw_prepend ['proxy_smtp_auth          off;'] -> proxy_smtp_auth => 'off'. Same translation, same value; node p8test.example.com.conf:8 holds exactly one 'proxy_smtp_auth off;'. The imaps mailhost gets the module's own default 'off', which is also nginx's default, so the effective config is unchanged.

Run-2 justification holds: Notify['Generated Upstream members for ${title} are: ...'] is declared by nginx_frontend_domain.pp:256, identical at baseline cf477c6, and reached through this class's unchanged puppet_infrastructure::nginx_frontend_domain { $domain: } (line 48, Array backend_hosts_and_ports). A notify resource reports an event on every run by design, so the migration did not cause it. DIFF B is identical to DIFF A; the only later commit (c893592) touches only .codex_state/migration_order.md.
